name: duplicate-hunter-monorepo
description: Production-quality GitHub App that detects duplicate or related GitHub Issues and Pull Requests

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/core && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/similarity && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/ai && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/config && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/database && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/github && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/github-app && npm run build --workspace=@duplicate-hunter/web && npm run build:action
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/webhook-verification.test.ts tests/config-parser.test.ts tests/signal-extraction.test.ts tests/similarity-fixtures.test.ts tests/prompt-injection.test.ts tests/comment-formatter.test.ts tests/maintainer-workflow.test.ts tests/end-to-end-workflow.test.ts

author: Duplicate Hunter Maintainers
